articles.title: Ellis Corrigan, 70, Machinist
articles.deck: Friends remember Ellis Corrigan for the many years of service to Bellwood.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Bellwood. Born in Bellwood in the years after the war, Ellis Corrigan spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Ellis Corrigan died in March at home on Mulberry Avenue, at the age of 70. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: Support the Seasonal Farmers Market
body: To the editor: I have lived on Spring Lane for 13 years, and I want to say what a difference the Cedar Hollow Garden Club has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the December meeting.
